Steps to Reproduce: 1. Install WSL, Ubuntu 24.04; 2. Use VS Code in WSL through VS Code Server; 3. Activate GitHub Copilot Chat and OpenAI o1, o3, GPT-4, GPT-3.5, Gemini 2.0 Flash model providers; 4. Setup ~/,bashrc profile like so:
\.bashrc

```sh alias ls='eza --icons' alias l='ls -l' alias la='ls -a' alias lt='ls --tree' alias dps='docker ps --format \"{{.ID}}\\t{{.Status}}\\t{{.Names}}\"' alias dc='docker compose' alias fd=fdfind alias lg=lazygit alias ld=lazydocker alias bat=batcat alias cat='bat --paging=never' # Created by `pipx` on 2024-11-22 11:38:08 export PATH="$PATH:/home/kenyawest/.local/bin" alias lj=lazyjournal alias norg='gron --ungron' alias ungron='gron --ungron' alias br='broot' source /home/kenyawest/.config/broot/launcher/bash/br # Set up fzf key bindings and fuzzy completion eval "$(fzf --bash)" export FZF_DEFAULT_OPTS='--no-height --no-reverse' export FZF_ALT_C_OPTS="--preview 'tree -C {} | head -200'" export FZF_CTRL_R_OPTS="--preview 'echo {}' --preview-window down:3:hidden:wrap --bind '?:toggle-preview'" # Using highlight (http://www.andre-simon.de/doku/highlight/en/highlight.html) export FZF_CTRL_T_OPTS="--preview '(highlight -O ansi -l {} 2> /dev/null || cat {} || tree -C {}) 2> /dev/null | head -200'" eval "$(zoxide init bash)" eval "$(oh-my-posh init bash --config /home/kenyawest/.poshthemes/illusi0n.omp.json)" ```

This means of installing Docker (rootless), `eza`, `bat`, `lazygit`, `lazydocker`, `fdfind`, `lazyjournal`, `gron`, `broot`, `fzf`, `oh-my-posh` and `zoxide` tools. Scripts are (tested only with Ansible):
scripts

```bash apt install -y \ bash \ curl \ wget \ unzip \ ncdu \ tree \ gpg \ gettext-base \ snapd \ locales \ rsync; apt install -y \ moreutils \ neofetch \ bat \ fd-find \ httpie \ cron \ hstr \ duf \ jq \ whois \ ripgrep \ micro \ btop \ sqlite3 \ nala; apt install -y \ libdbus-1-dev \ pkg-config \ libsmbclient; apt install -y \ python3-docker \ python3-passlib \ python3-bcrypt; # Install eget by yourself manually before this EGET_GITHUB_TOKEN=token # Your GitHub PAT with no access rights, just to comply with API rate limit eget eza-community/eza --asset gnu --asset tar.gz eget junegunn/fzf eget jesseduffield/lazydocker eget jesseduffield/lazygit eget tstack/lnav --asset lnav eget koenbollen/jl eget mikefarah/yq --asset yq_linux_amd64 eget ducaale/xh eget orf/gping --asset "^musl" eget jkfran/killport eget Lifailon/lazyjournal eget bensadeh/tailspin eget tomnomnom/gron eget PaulJuliusMartinez/jless eget https://dystroy.org/broot/download/x86_64-linux/broot eget extrawurst/gitui eget solidiquis/erdtree --asset "^gnu" eget fioncat/otree eget ajeetdsouza/zoxide eget veeso/termscp eget cupcakearmy/autorestic eget mr-karan/doggo --asset "^web" eget babarot/gomi eget Byron/dua-cli eget peltho/tufw --asset "tar.gz" ```

5. `source ~/.bashrc` to apply changes; 6. Make sure WSL picks up this profile; 7. Make sure VS Code picks up this profile in terminal; 8. Encounter any possible `stderr` output in terminal; 9. Try to resolve it with `#terminalLastCommand` command; 10. See output like so: ```text Based on the context, it looks like the error was triggered by the zoxide hook command. For bash on Linux, zoxide needs proper initialization. You might not need to run the __zoxide_hook command manually. Instead, ensure that zoxide is initialized in your shell configuration. For example, add the following line in your ~/.bashrc file: eval "$(zoxide init bash)" After updating ~/.bashrc, restart your terminal or run: source ~/.bashrc This should properly load zoxide and its hook. If the error persists, please provide the full error message for further troubleshooting. ``` And output is the same in terms of answer every time I use `#terminalLastCommand`
